headline: Transfer rumors, news: PSG eye Chelsea's Estêvão, Bayern's Luis Díaz amid injury woes
description: Paris Saint-Germain have added Bayern Munich's Luis Díaz and Chelsea's Estêvão to their shortlist. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Premier League's set-piece goal surge is over, but Arsenal are No. 1 anyway
description: Arsenal won the Premier League in controversial fashion last season, but the set-piece goals they counted on have disappeared. Why?

headline: David Moyes accepts James Tarkowski red card in Everton defeat to Brentford
description: Everton manager David Moyes said he understood why James Tarkowski was shown a straight red card in the 4-0 defeat to Brentford.

headline: Vitaly Janelt hits stunner as Brentford stroll to victory over 10-man Everton
description: Vitaly Janelt scored a 30-yard screamer as Brentford romped to a 4-0 victory against 10-man Everton at the Gtech Community Stadium.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Manchester United eye move for Ivan Toney
description: Manchester United are looking to improve their attack by signing Al Ahli's Ivan Toney. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Oli McBurnie is Hull's 'Braveheart,' says Sergej Jakirovic after Brighton win
description: Hull manager Sergej Jakirovic has likened striker Oli McBurnie to Scottish warrior William Wallace, as depicted by Mel Gibson in the 1995 film Braveheart.
